cards.name: Carcel, the Ohmechanic Light

effects.lua_implementation: Link procedure accepts 3+ and subgroup-checks for an Ohmechanic.

official_references.matched_structure: 3+ Link material procedure with subgroup requirement.

effects.printed_clause: If Link Summoned, Special Summon 1 "Ohmen" from GY; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed summon-success trigger checks SUMMON_TYPE_LINK and revives a Necrovalley-legal Ohmen under key id.

effects.printed_clause: ATK is doubled while it has a Current Counter.
effects.lua_implementation: Single-range EFFECT_SET_ATTACK_FINAL returns twice base ATK when counter count is positive.

effects.printed_clause: If this card becomes co-linked, place counters equal to combined Link Ratings of all co-linked monsters on this card and all monsters co-linked to it.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_ADJUST detects mutual linking, uses a handler flag to prevent repeated placement during one continuous co-linked interval, and explicitly resets that flag when the card ceases to be co-linked so a later transition can trigger again.

effects.printed_clause: When opponent activates a card/effect: remove all Current Counters on your field (min. 5); destroy all opponent monsters; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_CHAINING against opponent effects totals face-up field counters, requires at least five, removes every Current Counter as cost, then destroys all opponent monsters under key id+200.

official_references.matched_structure: Opponent-chain Quick Effect with cost, negation/destruction-style operation, and HOPT.

cards.audit_note: Rejected the reported defect. The EVENT_ADJUST operation already calls ResetFlagEffect when Carcel is no longer co-linked, allowing a later co-link transition to place counters again.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
